visual_elements.description: Horizontal pipeline flowchart. Nodes in order: beige oval 'Training Data' (top-left) -> curved red arrow down -> pale yellow box 'Pre processing' -> red arrow -> light blue box 'Feature Extraction' -> red arrow -> light green box 'Feature Selection' -> red arrow -> dark red box 'Classification' (white text) -> red arrow -> lavender/purple box 'Post processing' -> curved red arrow down-right -> yellow oval 'Final Result'. Beneath the arrows between consecutive boxes sit small gray rounded-rectangle labels: 'Cleaned Data' (between Pre processing and Feature Extraction), 'Feature Vectors' (between Feature Extraction and Feature Selection), 'Final Features' (between Feature Selection and Classification), 'Predicted Class' (between Classification and Post processing). All connecting arrows are red with triangular arrowheads pointing in flow direction.

recreation_brief: 1. White background slide. 2. Top center: red bold title 'The Complete ML Classification Process' with 'Classification' underlined. 3. Top-right: yellow circle with thin dark outline containing '30'. 4. Draw a thin red rectangular border framing the area below the title. 5. Inside frame, upper-left: beige oval with bold text 'Training Data'. 6. Draw five rectangles left-to-right in a horizontal row: pale yellow 'Pre processing', light blue 'Feature Extraction', light green 'Feature Selection', dark red 'Classification' with white bold text, lavender 'Post processing'. 7. Connect Training Data oval to Pre processing with a curved red arrow; connect consecutive boxes with straight red arrows. 8. Below the gaps between boxes place small light-gray rounded rectangles reading 'Cleaned Data', 'Feature Vectors', 'Final Features', 'Predicted Class' respectively. 9. Lower-right: yellow oval 'Final Result' with bold text; draw a curved red arrow from Post processing down to it. 10. Use sans-serif font (e.g., Arial/Calibri), black bold text in boxes, gray text in output labels.
